emptyDescription: Ask a question. Anything that writes outside this conversation asks you first.
composerPlaceholderApproval: Approve or reject the pending tool first.
composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
switchModel: Switch the response model for this conversation.
invalidCommandSyntax: Close the open quote or remove the trailing escape before running this command.
unknownCommand: {command} is not available in this conversation.
contextCompactsAutomatically: Context for {model} compacts automatically when needed.
compactDescription: Summarises the older part of the conversation so the model keeps the gist and context frees up. One model call.
compactUnavailable: Nothing to compact yet. The conversation still fits in what a compaction keeps.
approvalHint: This tool writes outside the conversation.
notePlaceholder: Tell the agent why, or what to do instead…
alwaysAllow: Allow all {tier} tools for the rest of this session
rewound: Went back, what was left behind
rewindDescription: Everything after it leaves the conversation and your message returns to the composer. The draft keeps its current state.
rewindSummarize: Keep a summary of what was left behind
forkDescription: A new conversation starts from this point with a copy of the draft. This one stays as it is.
deleteSessionDescription: The transcript and its drafts will no longer be available.

errorHeadlines.auth: The provider rejected the API key
errorHeadlines.quota: The provider account is out of quota or credit
errorHeadlines.rate_limited: The provider is rate limiting requests
errorHeadlines.context_overflow: The conversation no longer fits the model's context. Compact it
errorHeadlines.budget_exhausted: The turn ran past its budget and was stopped

connectionLost: Lost the connection to the agent. Reload to try again.
quotaExceeded: This week's free allowance is used up. It resets {resetAt}.
tooManyTurns: Too many replies are in progress at once. Wait for one to finish.
signedOut: Your session has ended. Reload the page to continue.
linkSafetyDescription: This link came from the agent and leads outside this site.
